title: Indiana woman who was at wrong home address to clean fatally shot by resident
summary: Officers found Maria Florinda Rios Perez De Velasquez dead after she accidentally went to a wrong property Authorities in Indiana are considering whether to charge a homeowner who they say shot and killed a woman after she mistakenly went to the wrong address where she thought she was turning up to clean a property. Police officers found Maria Florinda Rios Perez De Velasquez, 32, dead just before 7am Wednesday on the front porch of a home in Whitestown, an Indianapolis suburb of about 10,000 people.
